def factor_volume_confirmed_momentum_asymmetry_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    # primary: 10-day momentum
    mom = close.pct_change(10)
    # volume weight: log volume ratio
    vol_mean = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = volume / vol_mean.replace(0, np.nan)
    weight = np.log(vol_ratio.clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0)) + 1.0
    
    # lightweight modifier: down-up range asymmetry
    range_ = high - low
    down_mask = close < open_
    up_mask = close > open_
    down_range = range_.where(down_mask, 0.0)
    up_range = range_.where(up_mask, 0.0)
    sum_down = down_range.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    count_down = down_mask.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    sum_up = up_range.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    count_up = up_mask.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    avg_down = sum_down / count_down.replace(0, np.nan)
    avg_up = sum_up / count_up.replace(0, np.nan)
    asymmetry = np.log(avg_down.clip(lower=1e-12)) - np.log(avg_up.clip(lower=1e-12))
    # dampen weight when asymmetry is high (absolute value)
    weight = weight * (1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(asymmetry)))
    
    factor = mom * weight
    df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_momentum_asymmetry_gate"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_confirmed_momentum_asymmetry_gate"]
description: Preserves the elite parent's momentum-volume synergy (high IC, RankIC, ICIR) while targeting improved robustness during periods of high intraday volatility asymmetry. The primary mechanism is 10-day momentum weighted by volume conviction (log of volume ratio to 20-day mean). The lightweight idea borrowed from the second parent dampens the weight when the down-up range asymmetry (log ratio of average down-day range to up-day range over 20 days) is large, as extreme asymmetry often signals reversal risk, reducing the reliability of momentum.
